name: MT101 to pain.001 Document Mapping for CBPR+
description: Maps MT101 message to ISO 20022 pain.001.001.09 CustomerCreditTransferInitiationV09 document structure according to CBPR+ translation specification

tasks.name: Initialize Temp Data
tasks.description: Initializes temp data with sender and receiver BIC codes for TR001 compatibility

tasks.name: Construct Group Header
tasks.description: Creates the pain.001 GroupHeader with message identification and initiating party information

tasks.name: Map Payment Information
tasks.description: Maps sequence A fields to PaymentInformation including debtor and debtor agent

tasks.name: Map Debtor
tasks.description: Maps field 50F/G/H from sequence A or B to Debtor and DebtorAccount

tasks.name: Map Debtor Agent
tasks.description: Maps field 52A/C from sequence A or B to DebtorAgent with TR003 logic

tasks.name: Map Credit Transfer Transactions
tasks.description: Maps each transaction from sequence B to CreditTransferTransactionInformation

tasks.name: Map Payment Type Information
tasks.description: Maps field 23E instruction codes to PaymentTypeInformation for each transaction

tasks.name: Apply Payment Type to Transactions
tasks.description: Applies the mapped payment type information to each credit transfer transaction

tasks.name: Handle Instruction for Debtor Agent
tasks.description: Maps field 23E OTHR instruction code to InstructionForDebtorAgent
